id.description: The unique identifier for a course

name.description: The name of the parent racetrack, e.g.: Tokyo

surface.description: Main surface on which the course is run on

events.description: Describe the shape of a course, influencing how horses run.

Straight.title: Straight event
Straight.description: A straight section on the course. Each straight section is marked by two separate events.

trigger_at.description: Distance in metres from the start of the course at which the event takes effect.

is_start.description: true if the event marks the beginning of a straight, false if it marks the end.

straight_id.description: Identifies the physical straight section. The same straight should ideally have the exact same ID.

type.description: Optional, defaults to 0 when initialising. Identifies the type of straight: 1 for homestraight, 2 for backstraight, 3 for false straight.

Corner.title: Corner event
Corner.description: A curved section on the course

trigger_at.description: Distance in metres from the start of the course at which the event takes effect.

direction.description: Direction of the Corner. -1 for left turn, 1 for right turn.

number.description: Optional. Usually seen in Japanese tracks. Labelling for various corner sections on the course, from 1 to 4.

Slope.title: Slope event
Slope.description: A sloped section on the course

trigger_at.description: Distance in metres from the start of the course at which the event takes effect.

length.description: How long the slope runs for

gradient.description: Gradient of the sloped section as a percentage, from -100 to 100. Please avoid writing values past -3 and 3 as horses may struggle taking extreme gradients.

SurfaceChange.title: SurfaceChange event
SurfaceChange.description: A change in surface on the course. This event should be used sparingly.

trigger_at.description: Distance in metres from the start of the course at which the event takes effect.

length.description: How long the new surface runs for

WidthChange.title: WidthChange event
WidthChange.description: A change in the course's maximum width. Avoid using this unless you actually need it.

trigger_at.description: Distance in metres from the start of the course at which the event takes effect.

change_to.description: New value to change course width to
